versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated the documentation to include the openclaw parameter in all API usage examples and endpoints.
- No changes to the core functionality or API; this version mainly reflects documentation improvements and cleanup.

- Initial release of the Archive2Figure (A2F) skill.
- Convert PDF archives into digital character figures with support for Chinese historical characters and realistic images.
- Workflow includes PDF upload, character feature extraction, image generation, and job status checking.
- Provides three main endpoints: extract features from PDFs, generate character images, and poll job status.
- Includes usage examples, parameter descriptions, and best practices in the documentation.
